approvedRevision.summary: COMPLETION_REQUESTED is not a story/task lifecycle phase. RequestCompletion is an idempotent command; successful validation emits Completed, rejection leaves work ACTIVE, and asynchronous review is a separate DAG branch.

initialCounterexample.resolution: Changed the runner default so only an explicit task model selects task transitions; the approved fixture expectation was not weakened.
